term: uniform local motion as a becoming
definition: Local motion, uniform motion included, is a becoming (devenir), a passage from potency to act throughout, and not a state: each passage from one position to the next is a change as much as the passage from rest to motion (Garrigou-Lagrange 1914, pp. 252, 254). On this sense a body persevering in uniform motion is `MovedIn` in that respect (DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION).
